settings.name: GAFFER_MODE
settings.description: Who approves and merges agent work: supervised (a person approves every merge), lite (trivial work is approved by the reviewer agent, a person merges), graduated (only what each repository earned ships on its own), autonomous (agents approve, merge and push inside the OS sandbox), strict (autonomous, and the sandbox wraps the agent even under the environment opt-out).

derives.name: REVIEW_MODE
derives.note: who reviews in_review tickets: human, agent (a reviewer agent, never the implementer) or both (an agent screens, a person approves)

derives.name: DISPATCH_ALLOW_AGENT_APPROVE
derives.note: 1 = dispatch accepts an approval the runner makes on an agent reviewer verdict (the env floor)

derives.name: MERGE_ON_AGENT_REVIEW
derives.note: 1 (with AUTO_MERGE) = an agent-approved ticket merges with no person in the loop

derives.name: AUTO_MERGE
derives.note: 1 = an approved ticket lands on the default branch without a second click

derives.name: GAFFER_AUTO_PUSH
derives.note: 1 = landed agent work is pushed to origin (a plain git push, from the runner)

derives.name: MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE
derives.note: 1 = a lesson an agent proposes goes live without review

derives.name: GAFFER_MEMORY_AUTO_PROMOTE
derives.note: follows MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE: 1 = a requirement distilled from a delivered ticket goes live at once; 0 = it lands as a draft

derives.name: GAFFER_SECURITY_REVIEW
derives.note: 1 = a delivery that touches a sensitive path gets a second, security-focused review; 0 disables the lane

derives.name: GAFFER_MERGE_LANE
derives.note: 1 = a tick lands a ticket that is ready to merge and allowed to (a person approved it, or it earned it); 0 = a person merges

derives.name: GAFFER_CONFLICT_RESOLVER
derives.note: 1 = a merge conflict is resolved by an agent and re-reviewed; 0 = the ticket waits for a person

derives.name: GAFFER_LITE_MAX_DIFF
derives.note: lite mode trivial-diff bounds as "lines=60 files=4" (the defaults)

derives.name: GAFFER_ALLOW_SELF_DELIVERY
derives.note: 1 = let the factory deliver to its own source (first-party dogfooding); 0 refuses

settings.name: GAFFER_DAILY_BUDGET_USD
settings.description: The most the factory may spend in one UTC day, in dollars; empty is no daily cap. A live run needs this or GAFFER_BUDGET_USD.

derives.name: GAFFER_PAUSE_ON_CAP
derives.note: 1 = a delivery that hits a turn or dollar cap is paused with its worktree kept, for a one-click Continue; 0 = park it and tear the worktree down

derives.name: GAFFER_USAGE_PAUSE_DEFAULT_MIN
derives.note: minutes admission pauses after a usage-limit refusal that printed no reset time (at least 10)

derives.name: GAFFER_KILL_ESTIMATE_USD
derives.note: dollars booked for a call killed or timed out before it reported its cost (the budget gates count it)

settings.name: GAFFER_BUDGET_USD
settings.description: The most the factory may spend in its lifetime (the whole usage ledger), in dollars; empty is no lifetime cap.

derives.name: GAFFER_BUDGET_LOW_THRESHOLD
derives.note: the dollar headroom at or under which the router picks one tier cheaper: 20% of GAFFER_BUDGET_USD, 0 when it is unset

derives.name: GAFFER_REWORK_BUDGET_USD
derives.note: follows GAFFER_BUDGET_USD: the most one ticket may spend across its rework attempts; empty = no ceiling but the attempt cap

derives.name: GAFFER_MAX_CALL_USD
derives.note: a hard dollar cap on each agent call (claude --max-budget-usd); empty = none

derives.name: GAFFER_CHEAP_PHASES
derives.note: phases routed one tier cheaper whatever the budget (implement, review, clarify); empty = none

settings.name: GAFFER_MODELS
settings.description: The three models, as "strong,standard,cheap" (each a model id), or a preset: standard (opus,sonnet,haiku), economy (sonnet,haiku,haiku), strong (opus,opus,sonnet).

derives.name: GAFFER_PLAN_MODEL
derives.note: the strong tier: planning, the final rework attempt, the eval judge

derives.name: GAFFER_IMPL_MODEL
derives.note: the implement tier: delivery when the router does not pick, review, the tester

derives.name: GAFFER_MODEL_TIERS
derives.note: the router's tiers over model-registry.json (strong, mid, cheap); unset = the registry's own (opus, sonnet, haiku)

derives.name: GAFFER_PLAN_DEBATE_MODELS
derives.note: the planning debate's proposer and critic

derives.name: GAFFER_ROLE_MODELS
derives.note: per-role models as "role=model" pairs (rework, scout, judge, tester, card, synth, inherit); an unnamed role keeps its default, which follows the tiers

derives.name: GAFFER_PLAN_DEBATE
derives.note: 1 turns on the two-model planning debate for a big epic (it multiplies planning cost); 0 = one planner

derives.name: GAFFER_PLAN_DEBATE_MAX_ROUNDS
derives.note: plan-producing rounds of a debate (the draft is round 1)

derives.name: GAFFER_PLAN_DEBATE_MIN_ESTIMATE
derives.note: the size signal a plan must reach before it is debated; 0 = any size

derives.name: GAFFER_SCOUT
derives.note: the pre-work scout: off (the free deterministic packet only), auto (plus one read-only cheap model call where it helps), none

derives.name: GAFFER_CLAUDE_AUTH_PROBE
derives.note: 1 = preflight asks the worker CLI whether its login works; 0 skips the probe

settings.name: GAFFER_EFFORT
settings.description: How much work one ticket may take: small, standard or large (time per agent call, turns, delivery attempts, gate and CI time).

derives.name: GAFFER_TICK_TIMEOUT
derives.note: wall-clock seconds one agent call may run before it is stopped

derives.name: GAFFER_MAX_TURNS
derives.note: agent turns per delivery call (claude --max-turns), and the ceiling for every role

derives.name: GAFFER_MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS
derives.note: agent attempts per delivery in one tick (the rework ladder); 1 = no rework

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD_TIMEOUT
derives.note: seconds each Definition-of-Done gate and each acceptance check command may run

derives.name: GAFFER_CI_POLL_ATTEMPTS
derives.note: CI status polls before the CI gate calls the checks still pending

derives.name: GAFFER_ROLE_MAX_TURNS
derives.note: per-role turn caps as "role=N" pairs (review, security_review, clarify, judge, tester, merge, po, scout, onboard, decompose, spec_author), each clamped to GAFFER_MAX_TURNS

derives.name: GAFFER_RETRY_FRESH_BRANCH
derives.note: 1 = a ticket re-entered by a later tick starts again from its base branch; 0 keeps its commits

derives.name: GAFFER_TICK_DEADLINE_GUARD
derives.note: 1 = a tick starts no attempt that its outer time bound would kill; 0 = off

derives.name: DISPATCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS
derives.note: follows GAFFER_MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS: rejections before dispatch parks a ticket for a person

derives.name: GAFFER_MAX_NOCOMMIT_FAILURES
derives.note: follows GAFFER_MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS: ticks that end with no commit before the ticket parks

derives.name: GAFFER_CI_POLL_INTERVAL_SECS
derives.note: seconds between CI status polls

settings.name: GAFFER_CONCURRENCY
settings.description: How many tickets the factory delivers at once (1 to 64).

derives.name: MAX_CANDIDATES
derives.note: ready candidates one tick scans before it reports no work: 25 per worker, at most 100 (0 = the whole list)

derives.name: MAX_TICKS
derives.note: ticks per loop run (a cost guard)

derives.name: MAX_TICKS_PER_DAY
derives.note: ticks per UTC day across loop runs; 0 = off

derives.name: EMPTY_POLL_LIMIT
derives.note: the loop stops after this many empty polls in a row

derives.name: TICK_SLEEP
derives.note: seconds between ticks

derives.name: MAX_CONCURRENT_TICKETS_PER_REPO
derives.note: tickets in flight for one repository at once

derives.name: MAX_OPEN_AGENT_BRANCHES_PER_REPO
derives.note: unmerged gaffer/* branches a repository may hold before new claims for it wait (0 = no limit)

derives.name: MAX_OPEN_AGENT_PRS_PER_REPO
derives.note: tickets in review for a repository before new claims for it wait (0 = no limit)

derives.name: GAFFER_WG_SERVE
derives.note: 1 = a tick sends its dispatch CLI and JSON helper calls to two long-lived processes; 0 runs each as its own process (troubleshooting)

derives.name: DRY_RUN
derives.note: 1 = print what would happen and never call an agent; `gaffer run` passes 0

settings.name: GAFFER_SANDBOX
settings.description: Which OS sandbox contains every agent: auto (sandbox-exec on macOS, else docker), docker or sandbox-exec. Running with none is only the environment opt-out GAFFER_STRICT_REQUIRE=0.

derives.name: SANDBOX_PROVIDER
derives.note: the OS sandbox provider every agent launch runs in (auto: sandbox-exec where it exists, else docker)

derives.name: STRICT_MODE
derives.note: 1 = wrap every agent launch in the provider. Effectively 1: 15-modes.sh turns it on whenever the sandbox is required (every mode); this 0 applies only under the environment opt-out GAFFER_STRICT_REQUIRE=0

derives.name: STRICT_ALLOW_NETWORK
derives.note: 1 = the sandbox lets the agent reach the network (the agent CLI needs its API); the docker provider still allows only its egress list

derives.name: STRICT_ALLOW_HOME
derives.note: HOME paths the sandbox may write (the agent CLI state and cache)

derives.name: GAFFER_SANDBOX_IMAGE
derives.note: the image the docker provider runs each delivery in (read in lib/sandbox-docker.sh)

derives.name: GAFFER_SANDBOX_LIMITS
derives.note: docker sandbox caps as "cpus=4 memory=4g pids=512"; a cap not named keeps that default

derives.name: GAFFER_MCP_BRIDGE
derives.note: docker provider: auto (on, except macOS) runs the MCP data plane on the host behind one socket; 1 forces on, 0 off

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD_SANDBOX
derives.note: 1 = the Definition-of-Done gates and criterion checks run inside the agent sandbox; 0 opts out, logged

derives.name: GAFFER_EGRESS_ALLOW
derives.note: extra hosts the docker sandbox egress proxy lets through (read in lib/egress-allowlist.mjs)

derives.name: GAFFER_REGISTRY_PROBE
derives.note: 1 = check before a docker launch that the package registries answer through the egress proxy; 0 skips it

derives.name: GAFFER_IDLE_HOST_EXEC
derives.note: 1 = allow idle repo commands (coverage, audit, oracles) on the host while the sandbox is required; 0 refuses them

settings.name: GAFFER_GATES
settings.description: The Definition-of-Done gates: standard (tests, lint and typecheck must pass) or strict (also a smallest-change note, tighter size flags, no flaky rerun). In the environment only, a list such as "tests,lint" runs only those.

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD_FLAKY_RERUN
derives.note: with GAFFER_CONCURRENCY above 1, rerun a red test gate once alone before it counts; 0 = a red gate counts at once

derives.name: MINIMALISM_REQUIRE_NOTE
derives.note: 1 = a delivery with no smallest-change note goes back to rework; 0 = it is flagged for the reviewer

derives.name: OVERSIZED_MAX_LINES
derives.note: a diff over this many changed lines is flagged oversized_diff for the reviewer (never failed)

derives.name: OVERSIZED_MAX_FILES
derives.note: a diff over this many changed files is flagged oversized_diff for the reviewer (never failed)

derives.name: GAFFER_REVIEW_RULE_REPEAT
derives.note: how many times the same review feedback must recur before it becomes a standing review rule (2..20)

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD_TESTS
derives.note: 1 = run the repository test gate on every delivery; 0 skips it

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD_LINT
derives.note: 1 = run the lint gate

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD_TYPECHECK
derives.note: 1 = run the typecheck gate (auto-detected command)

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD_TYPECHECK_CMD
derives.note: the typecheck command, instead of the auto-detected one

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD_ENV_PASS
derives.note: extra environment variable names every gate run receives (credential-shaped, factory and loader names are refused whatever is listed)

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD
derives.note: 0 turns every Definition-of-Done gate off, the only way to land a delivery ungated (read in lib/dod.sh)

derives.name: GAFFER_DOD_INSTALL
derives.note: 1 = install the delivery worktree dependencies from its lockfile before the test gate; 0 to manage them yourself (read in lib/dod.sh)

derives.name: GAFFER_ALLOW_NO_DOD
derives.note: 1 = let a delivery pass when no gate ran at all; otherwise that parks the ticket (read in lib/tick-gates.sh)

derives.name: HYGIENE_ENFORCE
derives.note: 1 = a delivery whose diff adds or deletes a forbidden path is parked; 0 only logs it

derives.name: HYGIENE_FORBIDDEN_PATHS
derives.note: the path fragments a delivery diff may never add or delete

derives.name: GAFFER_SENSITIVE_PATH_RE
derives.note: the paths that count as sensitive (lite never auto-approves them; they get the security second opinion); empty = the built-in list

derives.name: GAFFER_EVAL_JUDGE
derives.note: 1 = a model judge scores each delivery against its criteria (advisory, one extra call); 0 = off

derives.name: GAFFER_JUDGE_DENIED_TOOLS
derives.note: the tools the eval judge is denied by name (read in lib/eval-judge.sh)

settings.name: GAFFER_LANDING
settings.description: How approved work lands: local (merged into the default branch of the repository on this machine) or pr (a pull request per delivery, merged through it once its CI is green).

derives.name: GAFFER_CREATE_PR
derives.note: 1 = open a pull request for each delivery (needs a GitHub remote and gh)

derives.name: GAFFER_REQUIRE_CI
derives.note: 1 = a delivery enters review only once its pull request checks are green

derives.name: GAFFER_PR_MERGE_METHOD
derives.note: how an approved pull request is landed: merge, squash or rebase

derives.name: GAFFER_PR_REMOTE
derives.note: the git remote delivery branches and pull requests are pushed to

derives.name: GAFFER_PR_LOCAL_FALLBACK
derives.note: 1 = when gh cannot merge the pull request, land the branch locally; 0 holds the ticket for a person

derives.name: GAFFER_CI_TIMEOUT_POLICY
derives.note: with CI required: block (the default) rejects a delivery whose checks time out; proceed lets it through with a note (read in lib/ci-gate.sh)

derives.name: GAFFER_PROVENANCE_TRAILERS
derives.note: 1 = a landed merge carries the ticket provenance trailers; 0 = the plain merge message

settings.name: GAFFER_TESTING
settings.description: The independent tester lane: auto (on where a repository has a test command), on (every testable ticket) or off (only the acceptance ticket of an epic).

derives.name: GAFFER_TESTER_REPLAY
derives.note: 1 = the runner replays the tester tests in a clean, contained checkout before a PASS counts; 0 holds every PASS for a person (read in runner/bin/tester-run.mjs)

settings.name: GAFFER_IDLE
settings.description: What the factory does when nothing is ready: auto (the Idle loops page decides), off, maintenance, backlog (plan the next feature) or all (also clarify and draft tickets).

derives.name: CLARIFY_DRAFTS_WHEN_IDLE
derives.note: 1 = an idle tick runs a clarify pass over an unspecified draft (spends tokens every idle tick)

derives.name: IDLE_DRAFT_WHEN_IDLE
derives.note: 1 = an idle tick may draft a new ticket from what it found

derives.name: GAFFER_MAINTENANCE
derives.note: the maintenance lane: empty = crew.yaml decides, 0 = off, 1 = forced on (a lane must still be enabled)

derives.name: GAFFER_IDLE_FEATURE_BACKLOG
derives.note: the feature-backlog planner: unset = crew.yaml decides, 1 = on, 0 = off (read by crew)

derives.name: GAFFER_IDLE_MODE
derives.note: what the idle loops may file: observe_only, create_draft_tickets or create_ready_tickets; unset = crew.yaml decides (read by crew)

settings.name: GAFFER_NOTIFY
settings.description: Where to tell a person: a webhook URL, a Slack incoming-webhook URL and/or "desktop", separated by commas or spaces; empty sends nothing.

derives.name: GAFFER_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL
derives.note: POST every gate event as JSON to this URL

derives.name: GAFFER_NOTIFY_SLACK_URL
derives.note: post every gate event to this Slack incoming webhook

derives.name: GAFFER_NOTIFY_DESKTOP
derives.note: 1 = a native desktop banner for every gate event

derives.name: GAFFER_NOTIFY_EVENTS
derives.note: which event kinds are sent (comma-separated); unset = every gate event (read by dispatch)

derives.name: GAFFER_NOTIFY_FULL_PAYLOAD
derives.note: 1 = send the full event text, including what an agent wrote; unset = redacted (read by dispatch)

settings.name: GAFFER_DATA
settings.description: Where the factory keeps its state (databases, logs, settings.json). Environment only: settings.json lives inside it.

derives.name: GAFFER_CODE_INDEX
derives.note: 1 builds the code index at onboard and after each merge and primes callers into file cards; 0 off

derives.name: GAFFER_BOOTSTRAP_ROOT
derives.note: the folder a greenfield (create-a-repo) ticket creates its repository under

settings.name: DISPATCH_API_PORT
settings.description: The port the dashboard serves on.

derives.name: GAFFER_DASHBOARD_URL
derives.note: the dashboard link in notifications: the --lan address `gaffer dashboard --lan` saved, else http://127.0.0.1:<DISPATCH_API_PORT>; set it when the dashboard sits behind a proxy

derives.name: DISPATCH_ALLOWED_HOSTS
derives.note: extra host names (comma-separated) the dashboard Host and Origin check accepts, for a reverse proxy or a DNS name in front of it (read by dispatch)

derives.name: GAFFER_DASHBOARD_START_TIMEOUT
derives.note: seconds a new dashboard server gets to come up (read in runner/gaffer)
